signal: Merge launched its Agent Handler giving AI agents secure access to third-party tools, was named to LinkedIn's 2025 Top Startups list, and now serves 7,000+ customers.

email.body1:
Tim, saw Merge ship the Agent Handler and land on LinkedIn's 2025 Top Startups list at 7,000-plus customers.

Growth like that usually means more in-market accounts surface than the team can act on before the signal goes stale, and that latency is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach automatically, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Merge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tim, quick follow-up for Merge.

On the RevOps side, the problem is rarely the data, it is the lag between a signal firing and a personalized touch going out. Multi-channel sequencing lifts responses 287% over single channel, but only if every in-market account actually gets worked while it is hot.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and how the AI SDR closes that signal-to-action gap.
email.body3:
Tim, last bit of proof for Merge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Merge's reply rate likely compares to other API-infra startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tim, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling toward 7,000 customers is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your RevOps motion? I will tailor it to Merge either way.
